editorialSections.label: Who We Are
editorialSections.headline: Private Luxury Expeditions
editorialSections.body: Adventure International designs unique journeys to the world's most extraordinary places, tailored from the knowledge of true adventure seekers and travel enthusiasts. We focus on supporting the travel industry with outfitting solutions in Africa, Asia, and the Americas — where we have our own in-country operations for trekking and adventure programs. Over a decade of experience curating trips ensures that clients are very well taken care of with highly qualified and trained guides.

editorialSections.label: Our Philosophy
editorialSections.headline: Sustainable, Ethical, Extraordinary
editorialSections.body: We combine luxury adventure travel and local communities into a symbiotic, life-changing experience for both the traveler and the local people. Our on-the-ground approach means our owners and managers are constantly on reconnaissance for new trips, our trip leaders personally guide private groups, and our most trusted local guides escort families and small groups on their next departure.
